[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Keep leaf projects moving — offer a sub-project's ready tasks when [/bold #D7AFFF]

[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]When any managed Done gesture, on any surface, closes the task [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]behind a leaf project's last live Task Link in today's Pomodoros, [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]says plainly why it appeared and that the rows are not dependents. [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Obsidian, `bob capture`, and Bob Mac Capture present it with one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]copy and visual system.[/#D7D7AF]
